decision: Keep GMW for the current streamed private-hash path; archive the rejected experimental route and comparison module. Retain the shared R2 completion cleanup fix.
scope: Four fixed hash candidates per preparation, consumed in two independent pairs. Live role state and raw input-independent R2 tables. This is not complete signing, durable admission, authenticated storage, or sustained wallet capacity.
public_trace_attribution: Kernel labels classify both roles by backend. Public cleanup events bind all six B invocations to exact client runs. A run IDs are unavailable; do not assert an exact A run join. CPU and provider wall time cover entire invocations, not stages.
limits: Small sequential component screen, not a sustained service or latency guarantee.
No complete signer, registration, recovery, durable admission, or authenticated-storage timing is measured.
Input conversion, protocol execution, R2 streaming and exact EOF validation are inside online timing; explicit finish and cleanup are outside.
Peer byte counts exclude WebSocket envelopes, acknowledgements, completion JSON, TCP/TLS and R2 transport overhead; raw payload counts are not wire billing totals.
Standalone GMW uses fresh silent correlation setup; production amortizes setup with other circuits. These preparation times do not establish full-refill savings.
Raw input-independent R2 tables and live private role state do not include production persistence or restart costs.
GMW readiness clocks report 0–4 ms despite 3.9–6.1 s client preparation. These phase clocks are unqualified and cannot separate computation from waits.
B location is unavailable; A ingress is NRT. Worker and bucket colocation is not established.
Wasm page counts exclude JS heap, transient host buffers and total isolate peak.
Half-gates uses less encoded private state and less aggregate whole-session CPU here; GMW is selected for measured latency and traffic.
Multipart creation-response loss and durable private-state recovery are outside the probe. Cleanup attempts deletion despite abort failure but does not acknowledge success after an abort error.
next: Reduce registration stock delivery and activation cost using existing stage evidence.
Profile complete multi-pair signing at storage/restore and protocol boundaries before another backend change.
Repeat full hosted registration, signing and sustained refill after a measured optimization with unchanged capacity.
